description: This file defines the internal server API interface for media decryption in Rialto, including factory and session management classes, as well as methods for decrypting media buffers and querying session states.

classes.name: IMediaKeysServerInternalFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of IMediaKeysServerInternal, inherits from IMediaKeysFactory.

classes.name: IMediaKeysServerInternal
classes.description: Interface for media decryption operations, including decrypting buffers and session management.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IMediaKeysServerInternalFactory instance.

methods.name: createMediaKeysServerInternal
methods.description: Creates a new media keys server internal instance for a specified key system.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted media buffer using a session ID, with a version that also accepts subsample data, IV, key ID, and a flag for last 15 bytes initialization.

methods.name: hasSession
methods.description: Checks if a session with the given ID is handled by this media keys instance.

methods.name: isPlayreadyKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if the session's key system is PlayReady.

methods.name: incrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Increments the usage counter for a session ID.

methods.name: decrementSessionIdUsageCounter
methods.description: Decrements the usage counter for a session ID.
